StatDef.label: biomass extraction speed
StatDef.description: Speed of biological processing at a Gene Vat. Cooking contributes 40%, Medicine 40% and Intellectual 20%. The skill multiplier scales from 50% at level 0 to 100% at level 5 and 150% at level 10, then more gradually to a configurable expert maximum at level 20 (200% by default). Each skill contributes independently. General work speed, sight and manipulation also affect the final speed. Artificial-part recovery uses separate medical surgery rules.

StatDef.label: biomass extraction yield
StatDef.description: Recovery of raw biomass from Gene Vat extraction. Skills above level 10 grant extra biomass, reaching a configurable maximum at level 20 (20% extra by default). Cooking contributes 40%, Medicine 40% and Intellectual 20%. Does not increase special body products or artificial-part salvage.
